text_block_list.name: Gorschin
text_block_list.text: ...Fire!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──放てぇっ！！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: *cough*... *cough*...
text_block_list.orig_text: ごほっ、ごほ……

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: *cough* *cough*
text_block_list.orig_text:
けふっ、
けふっ。

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: What's going on now...?!
text_block_list.orig_text: いったい何が……！？

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: Was that blast one of your spells, Miss Karyl...?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
キャルさまの魔法ですか、
今の爆発は……！？

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
Of course not!
...But what the heck [i]was[/i] it?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
違うわよっ！
……でも
何なのいったいっ！？

text_block_list.name: Gorschin
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh...!
So you show your true colors, felons!
At this point, it falls to me to... Ngh!
text_block_list.orig_text:
むうっ……！
ついに本性を現したな反逆者どもめ！
かくなる上は、
吾輩直々に……
っ！

text_block_list.name: Soldier 1
text_block_list.text:
Chairman Gorschin!
The explosion blew a hole in the roof...
Something's coming from above!
text_block_list.orig_text:
──ゴウシン議長！
今の爆発で、
天井に穴が開いて……
上から、
何かがっ！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRRRRAAAAGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Gorschin
text_block_list.text:
Wha—?!
Monsters, here?!
Underground or no, this is the royal palace! What are the guards—?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぬっ！？
魔物だとっ！！
地下とはいえ王宮の中だぞ、
見張りは何をっ……

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRRRRAAAAGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Gorschin
text_block_list.text: Nguaaahhhh?!
text_block_list.orig_text: ぬわあーっ！？

text_block_list.name: Soldier 2
text_block_list.text: Chairman Gorschiiiiin!
text_block_list.orig_text: ゴウシン議長ぉーっ！？

text_block_list.name: Soldier 1
text_block_list.text: Fire! Fire!
text_block_list.orig_text:
撃て、
撃てっ！

text_block_list.name: Soldier 2
text_block_list.text:
...I-it's not working!
Our arrows just bounce off!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……き、
効いてねえ！
矢が弾かれる！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRRRRAAAAGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Soldiers
text_block_list.text: Guaaahhhhh!
text_block_list.orig_text: うわああああーっ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Hey!
Aren't these monsters...?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねえ！
あの魔物って……！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
They're the same ones that attacked the plaza a few hours ago!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ！
数時間前に、
広場を襲った魔物と同じ個体だ！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Which means...!
text_block_list.orig_text: ってことは……！

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
...Hey.
Finally, I found you losers.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──よォ。
見つけたぜ、
テメーら。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
That boy...!
He really did come back!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの子……！
やっぱりまた来たんだ！

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text:
\"Finally\"...? This suggests the boy has decided
to make us his specific targets.
Unlike before...
text_block_list.orig_text:
見つけた……
ということは、
今度は明確に
わたくしたちを狙って来たのですか。
先ほどと違って……

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
That's the deal.
To achieve my goal, I gotta get rid of anyone who'll get in the way.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そーいうこった。
オレの「目的」のタメにゃ、
邪魔なヤツを先に叩くほうがイイっぽいんでね。

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: Your goal...?
text_block_list.orig_text: 目的……？

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Who even are you...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あなたは、
いったい……

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
My name's Kariza.
Kariza of Rage Legion.
text_block_list.orig_text:
オレの名は、
カリザ。
──【レイジ・レギオン】のカリザだ。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: ...\"Kariza,\" huh...
text_block_list.orig_text:
カリザ……
くん。

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text:
...\"Rage Legion\"...
Could that be the name of the guild that this boy belongs to...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……【レイジ・レギオン】……
それが、
あの方の所属するギルドの名なのでしょうか……？

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
I doubt you've suddenly learned good manners.
When we asked your name before, you laughed at the question.
What makes this time different?
text_block_list.orig_text:
急に礼儀正しくなったとは思えない。
さっきは名を問われても、
鼻で笑って答えたというのに。
どういう心境の変化だ？

text_block_list.name: Kariza
text_block_list.text:
Good manners...?
As if I give a crap about those.
text_block_list.orig_text:
礼儀正しいだァ？
んなつもりはカスほどもねーよ。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Then what's your deal?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあ、
なんだってのよ！？

text_block_list.name: Kariza
text_block_list.text:
Nothing's changed.
I could crush \"stray stones\" like you without even trying.
...But I messed it up once already.
text_block_list.orig_text:
前も今も。
テメーらを石ころみてーに潰すなんざ、
少しも難しいたぁ思えねェ。
……けど、
それで一回ミスったからな。

text_block_list.name: Kariza
text_block_list.text:
So, y'see.
This time, I figure I'll treat you as enemies.
As a threat that needs destroying.
text_block_list.orig_text:
だから。
今度はちゃんと、
敵として見てやるよ。
敵として、
キッチリ潰してやる。

text_block_list.name: Kariza
text_block_list.text:
That's why I told you my name.
To give you a at least a bit more value.
Stray stones on the path don't call me by name, do they?
text_block_list.orig_text:
わざわざ名乗ってやったのは、
テメーらの価値を上げてやるためだ。
ただの石ころは、
オレの名前を呼んだりしねーからな。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
...I don't quite get it...
But I guess you mean you're taking us seriously?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……よくわかんないけど……
もう油断しない、
ってことなのかな。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Honestly, I'd rather avoid all this fighting to begin with...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ホントは、
戦わないのが一番なんだけどっ……！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
But the boy doesn't seem willing to relent.
In fact, he gave his name because he means to fight. Is that right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
だが向こうは、
矛を収めるつもりはないようだ。
むしろ、
いちいち名乗ったのもこちらと戦うため……
そうだろう？

text_block_list.name: Kariza
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Well, that and...
I was getting sick of the mangy cat
calling me stuff like \"runt\" and \"brat\"!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あァ。
まあ、
あとは……
クソ猫からチビだのガキだの呼ばれるのが
ウルセーってのもあるけどな？

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
Who're you calling mangy?!
I've been stuck in a prison cell where an upstart noble almost killed us,
so I'm [i]not[/i] in the mood for your mouth right now!
text_block_list.orig_text:
誰がクソ猫よっ！
こっちは閉じ込められた上に
三下貴族から殺されかけて、
めちゃくちゃイライラしてたんだから！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
You dumb runt!
Lousy brat!
This time, I'm killing you so dead!
text_block_list.orig_text:
このクソチビ！
クソガキっ！
今度こそ、
絶対ぶっ殺すわ！

text_block_list.name: Kariza
text_block_list.text: ...Hah.

text_block_list.name: Kariza
text_block_list.text:
Murder them, monster scum.
Crush that cage and mince these morons' guts!
text_block_list.orig_text:
──ブチ殺せ。
クソ魔獣ども。
その檻ごと、
ヤツらのハラワタを食い破れ。

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRRRRAAAAGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Waahhh!
text_block_list.orig_text: ひうっ！

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text:
Even a high security prison cell reinforced with magic
will not last long under an assault of this magnitude!
text_block_list.orig_text:
脱獄対策の防御魔法がかかった頑丈な檻でも……
あの勢いで攻撃を続けられたら、
長くは持ちません……！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
Guys, get back!
I didn't want to use this against humans,
but if it's monsters, I can blast 'em...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
みんな、
下がって！
人間相手じゃ使いにくかったけど、
こいつらなら攻撃魔法でっ……！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
Wait!
These monsters still have that aura.
Our attacks won't have any effect!
text_block_list.orig_text:
待て！
魔物を覆うあのオーラがある限り、
我々の攻撃は通じないぞ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah...! Then, um... um... Yui!
Can you do that glowy thing one more time?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだったー！　
えーっとじゃあ、
ユイちゃん！
さっきの光った魔法、
使える！？

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Huhhhh...?!
U-ummmm...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええっ！？
う、
う～～んっ……！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
Please try, Yui!
It's the only chance we have to overcome them right now!
text_block_list.orig_text:
頼む、
ユイ！
この状況を打開する手立ては、
あれ以外に無いんだ……！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
...I'm so sorry!
Without knowing the incantation or effects, I really can't...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ごめんなさい！
やっぱり、
呪文も効果もよくわからないままじゃ……！

text_block_list.name: Kariza
text_block_list.text:
Hah!
Like I thought! That weird flashy magic
isn't something you can use on command!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ハッ！
思った通り……
さっきのヘンな光は
まだ使いこなせてねーみてーだな！

text_block_list.name: Kariza
text_block_list.text:
If you can't erase my power,
you don't stand a chance against my monsters!
I'll kill you dead in no time, pink-haired girl!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こっちの強化が消せなきゃ、
ウチの魔獣どもにゃ手も足もでねーだろ！
すぐにブチ殺してやるぜ、
ピンク髪……！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: We won't let you do that!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんなこと、
させないよっ……！

text_block_list.name: Kariza
text_block_list.text:
Sure!
I ain't just after her!
I'll crush all you punks, then flatten this whole palace as well!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ！
ピンク髪だけじゃねェ！
テメーらを潰したら、
ついでにこの王宮もペシャンコにしてやらぁ！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Why...?
Why would you want to do these things?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんで……
どうしてそんなひどいことを……！？

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: Could he have some manner of grudge against this kingdom?
text_block_list.orig_text:
もしや、
この国に
何か恨みを持っているのでしょうか……？

text_block_list.name: Kariza
text_block_list.text:
Hah! Fat chance of that.
This is all just a means of granting my wish!
A wish I'd never be able to grant in any normal way!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ハっ！　
んなもんねーよっ。
すべては、
オレの──「願いを叶える」ためさッ！
普通にやったんじゃ、
どうやっても届かない願いをな！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
To grant a wish...?
So that's the \"goal\" you mentioned...
text_block_list.orig_text:
願いを、
叶える……？
それがさっき言っていた「目的」か……

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
But hold on!
Wrecking the town and hurting people...?
Nasty stuff like that won't make wishes come true!
text_block_list.orig_text:
でもでもっ！
町やあたしたちを、
傷つけたりしたって……
そんなひどいコトしたって、
叶うワケないよ！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Agreed! If anything, you'd be better off
climbing the Tower of Sol with us!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん！
それよりも、
わたしたちと一緒に
ソルの塔の一番上を目指したほうが……！

text_block_list.name: Kariza
text_block_list.text:
...Ehhh?
The Tower of Sol?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あァ？
ソルの塔だ？

text_block_list.name: Kariza
text_block_list.text:
...Hah!
You really don't know a damn thing, huh?
text_block_list.orig_text:
──ハッ！
マジで何もしらねーんだなテメーら。

text_block_list.name: Kariza
text_block_list.text:
That tower's just an empty husk.
Nothing left up at the top. Just an empty birdcage.
You won't get any wishes granted there.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あそこはもう、
抜け殻だよ。
テッペンまでいっても何もない、
ただの空っぽのトリカゴさ。
願いなんざ、
叶うワケがない。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Whaaaaaa...?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ……？　
ええええっ……！？

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
No way...!
Then what have our efforts as Twinkle Wish been for...?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんな……！
じゃあわたしたち
【トゥインクルウィッシュ】の活動はっ……！？

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
Kariza, is that the truth?!
And if so, why would you have knowledge of—
text_block_list.orig_text:
カリザ、
それは本当か！？
本当なら、
キミは何故それを知って……

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRRRRAAAAGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh!
They have bitten through the bars of our cell!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああっ！
檻が、
食い破られてしまいました……！

text_block_list.name: Kariza
text_block_list.text:
Go on! Try to resist me!
I'll crush all your pathetic attempts
and leave you as stains on the wall!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そぉら、
抵抗しやがれ！
テメーらの無駄な足掻きを捻じ伏せて、
薄汚れた壁に叩きつけてやらァ！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: Nghhh...!
text_block_list.orig_text: ぐうっ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Aaahhhh!
text_block_list.orig_text: あああっ！

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Unhhhh...!
text_block_list.orig_text: ひぅぅっ……！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRRRRAAAAGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！
